item.title: Professional Portrait Without Changing My Face

turns.text: I'd like a professional headshot, but please keep my face recognisably me. Don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. Just tidy up the lighting, outfit and background.

item.tests: Improves professional presentation without beautification that changes facial identity, apparent age or skin texture.

answer_sheet.Face and retouching: Keep my facial proportions, expression, apparent age and natural skin texture. No face reshaping or beauty filter.

must_haves: The face closely matches the source in eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline and facial proportions.
Her apparent age and natural skin texture are retained rather than airbrushed or de-aged.
Her curly dark hair and original expression remain recognisable.
The casual sweater is replaced with a professional outfit.
The park background is replaced with an unobtrusive headshot backdrop, with flattering natural-looking lighting.

plan.say: I’ll edit the portrait into a professional headshot with soft lighting, a tailored blazer and a neutral background. Then I’ll check that her facial identity, apparent age and skin texture are preserved.

params.prompt_or_change: Change only the lighting, outfit and background: use soft professional studio lighting, a tailored blazer and a clean neutral studio background; preserve the woman's facial identity, facial features, apparent age, natural skin texture, expression, hairstyle, pose and framing; do not retouch or reshape her face.

steps.why: Improve the supplied portrait rather than generate a different person.

params.prompt_or_change: Compare the edited headshot with the original: are facial identity, apparent age and natural skin texture preserved, with changes limited to lighting, outfit and background? Give a yes or no with reasons.

steps.why: Verify the requested preservation rather than assume the edit maintained identity.

ran.note: pass: Yes—the facial features, apparent age, small facial marks and natural skin texture appear preserved, with differences consistent with lighting, outfit and background changes.
